verdict.rationale: Shopify's developer docs say the official Shopify CLI is used to scaffold POS UI extensions, so an official CLI exists in the POS ecosystem. The evidence covers only extension scaffolding, not operating or managing POS itself from the command line, and it comes from a single brief mention. Missing for 10: CLI commands for POS operations (orders, inventory, staff, locations), documentation of agent or AI-driven CLI workflows, CLI reference depth beyond scaffolding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
